selection_rule: Use VT train2017 scenes absent from both official DeepPro RGB-T train/test manifests; require one original track_id with ignore=iscrowd=0, bbox w/h in (0,12], in 160 consecutive numeric raw filenames; choose lexicographic sequence, numeric track_id, earliest start. Retain ALL annotations in selected frames.
limitations: Not listed in DeepPro train/test does not establish independent scene identity.
Annotated presence and image-coordinate movement do not prove physical stop/restart.
COCO segmentation polygons here are rectangles around boxes, not verified pixel masks.
